systemPrompt: Convert Korean project names to English GitHub repo slugs. Rules: 1) lowercase, 2) hyphens only, 3) 2-4 words, 4) each word max 15 chars (truncate longer), 5) total slug max 50 chars. Output ONLY JSON: {"result":"the-slug","status":"ok"}. Example: 'SW 설계 개발' → {"result":"sw-design-development","status":"ok"}, '보안강화프로젝트' → {"result":"security-enhancement-project","status":"ok"}
